resources.string: No recent files. Open a PDF here, or from another app with “Open with” or “Share” to PhilPDF.
This file is no longer available (moved, deleted or permission removed). Open it again with “Open a file”.
Highlight, underline, strike out, notes, drawing: next step, with saving (same file or another name).
Drawn signature, initials, stamps and forms: next step, with your stamps and signatures from PhilPDF Windows.
This document cannot be annotated (it is not an editable PDF).
Scroll and zoom. Long press on an annotation: change its color, line or text, or delete it.
Slide your finger over the text to mark, from the first word to the last.
Touch the page where the note goes, then type its text.
Touch an annotation (highlight, drawing, note, stamp…) or rub over it to erase it. To erase the text or images of the page: “Erase an area of the page”.
Slide your finger on the page. While a tool is selected, the page does not scroll: “Done” to go back to reading.
“%1$s”: save to the same file, or under another name (the original stays as it is)?
A preview appears on the page: drag it where you want (or touch the page), then “Place here”. Long press on it afterwards to change or delete it.
Form: touch a field of the page to fill it in (text, check box, list). Signature, initials or stamp: choose it below, then touch the page.
Sign with your finger in the box
Draw your initials in the box

Link PhilPDF to the storage where PhilPDF Windows syncs its “PhilPDF” folder (Preferences, Synchronization): you will find your other computers, your signatures and your stamps here.\n\nGoogle Drive: just choose one of the Google accounts already on this phone, no password needed. As on Windows, PhilPDF only reads its own folder, never the rest of your storage.
To open or save a document, all your accounts (Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, NAS…) are already offered by “Open a file” and “Other name…”.
No PhilPDF folder from PhilPDF Windows on this account. Check which one is set in PhilPDF Windows (Preferences, Synchronization), then “Disconnect” to choose another.
Signatures and stamps from your computers
Then: in a document, “Sign”, section “From your computers”.

Google does not yet allow PhilPDF Android to connect directly with %1$s.\n\nSolution: the Google page opens in the browser with your account already chosen; touch “Allow”, then “Back to PhilPDF”. Only once.
Waiting for your approval in the browser…
Your PhilPDF computers have %1$d signature(s) or stamp(s) to retrieve.
Your signatures and stamps from PhilPDF Windows: link your sync account (Home, circle at the top right).
Your signatures and stamps from PhilPDF Windows: Home, circle at the top right, “Retrieve to this phone”.
Drag the preview where you want (or touch the page), then “Place here”.
Does your PhilPDF Windows sync elsewhere? Choose the same location (the service page opens in the browser, then “Back to PhilPDF”):

Link your storage accounts: you open your PDFs there (and “Same file” sends them back there), and the account where PhilPDF Windows syncs its “PhilPDF” folder gives you back your other computers, your signatures and your stamps. No password is given to PhilPDF.
Disconnect %1$s (%2$s)? PhilPDF Android will no longer sync with your computers; nothing is deleted on the account itself.
The service page opens in the browser: accept, then touch “Back to PhilPDF” (PhilPDF finishes the connection once you are back).
Approval received: touch “Back to PhilPDF” in the browser, or come back here.
Only folders and PDFs are shown. After editing, “Same file” sends the PDF back to its place on the account.
What happened (most recent first): account connections, sync, updates, errors. Tokens and codes are hidden. “Share” to send it if there is a problem.

PhilPDF Android finds your other PhilPDF computers, your signatures and your stamps in the “PhilPDF” folder that PhilPDF Windows syncs (Windows: Preferences, Synchronization). Choose the same location here.
To open or save your PDFs, nothing to link here: “Open a file” and “Other name…” use the Android file manager, which already sees all your accounts (Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, NAS…).
Choose the signature or stamp that takes its place.
Touch a line of text on the page: you edit it in a window. Only the letters are replaced (background, frames and images stay), with the PDF\'s original font when it has all the letters typed.
Text (one line here = one line on the page)
The original font does not have these letters: %1$s. The text will be written in %2$s (the closest).
Bold or italic changed: the text will be written in %1$s.
Original font (%1$s) cannot be used to rewrite: the text will be written in %2$s.
“Align right” keeps the right edge of the line (amounts, dates in a column). “Undo” (arrow at the top) reverts the change.
The text no longer fits in its frame (banner, cell): shorten it or reduce the size; Undo puts it back.
Touch to select · double touch to go to the page · long press then drag to move
They are removed from the document. “Undo” (arrow at the top) brings them back as long as you have not closed the document.
%1$d page(s) saved in a new PDF.
This file cannot be added (unreadable PDF or protected by a password).

Like “Reduce size” in PhilPDF Windows: photos and over-detailed scans are brought down to the chosen resolution, the rest of the file is recompressed. Text and black-and-white images are not touched. It applies when saving; “Undo” puts everything back.
The password will be asked to open the PDF (AES 256 encryption). It applies when saving: keep it safe, it cannot be recovered.
A comma is not allowed in a password.
Remove the password from the PDF
images brought down to %1$d dpi, quality %2$d %%
The PDF as an attachment (e-mail, messaging…).
The PDF is placed in PhilPDF/Partages on %1$s; the link goes in the message (handy for a large file). The link is also copied.
First link a sync account (Home, circle at the top right).
Draw the field area with your finger (a check box: touch or draw a small square). Its name is taken from the nearby text; long press on a field to rename or delete it.
Looking for areas to fill in…
No area to fill in was found (dotted lines, lines, boxes, empty frames). You can draw the fields with “Text field” and “Check box”.
Uncheck what is not a field; correct the names if needed. Nothing is placed before “Create”.
Draw the signature box with your finger (or touch: standard box), then type the certificate password.
Signature recognized by Acrobat, as on Windows. Touch a certificate, then draw the box on the page.
No certificate on this phone: import a .pfx file or retrieve those from your computers.
The certificate is kept encrypted on this phone; its password will be asked at each signature.
The certificates of PhilPDF Windows are read from your sync account (encrypted file of shared passwords). Type the passphrase chosen on Windows.
Document signed. Where to save it? (It is saved as it is: a later change would break the signature.)
This PDF has no digital signature.
Invalid signature: the document was modified or the signature is damaged.
Valid signature, but the document has been modified since.
Valid signature; self-signed certificate not trusted (add it to the trusted certificates if you trust it).
Valid signature; certificate not trusted on this phone.
Erase an area of the page
Draw the area to erase: the text, images and lines of the page are removed there (like the “erase” retouch on Windows). “Undo” puts them back.
No annotation here. To erase the page content: Erase > “Erase an area of the page”.
empty = name taken from the nearby text
Mask: 9 = digit, A = letter, X = anything
One line per value of the chosen field: “value: choice 1; choice 2”.
On your computers: touch to retrieve it (passphrase).
Stored in the Windows certificate store: it does not leave that PC. On Windows, add it to PhilPDF from its .pfx file to find it here.
Remember the passphrase on this phone (the certificates will follow on their own)
No transferable certificate: on Windows, check “Share passwords” and that your certificates are .pfx files (not only in the Windows store).

Personal self-signed certificate (RSA 3072, SHA-256), as in PhilPDF Windows. It is kept encrypted on this phone and placed in the synced PhilPDF folder (protected by its password): your Windows computers pick it up.

PhilPDF reads the text of scanned pages and images (photos, posters, logos). It is placed invisibly under the image: the page keeps its look, and the text can be searched, copied and edited. Text already present is not doubled. Everything happens on this phone, nothing is sent.
%1$d word(s) recognized on %2$d page(s). Remember to save.
No text recognized in the images (text too small, too blurry or too decorated).
Several languages possible for a mixed document. ↓: downloaded only once (Tesseract project), then kept on the phone.
Installed by Google Play: updates come through the Play Store.
Also look for sideways or upside-down text (folded booklet, vertical text): slower
No text recognized. If it is upside down or sideways, check “Also look for sideways or upside-down text”.
This page already has text and no image to read: nothing to recognize.
Checked by default (and checked again by “Reset”)
Code made by PhilPDF (follows the settings, in gray) and yours, kept as it is.
My code only: no longer write PhilPDF\'s code for this event
Arrange the fields in filling order (arrows).
Clear the whole form (default values restored)?
This file contained leftovers from an old version of PhilPDF (page(s) %1$s): Acrobat showed these pages blank. They have been removed, the page is intact. Save to keep the fix.
No image here. Touch an image on the page.
This image is repeated elsewhere in the document (the same logo on several pages, for example): changing it here would change all its copies.
Touch an image on the page: drag it to move it, the square handle enlarges it, the round one rotates it. Below: quarter turn, mirror, recognize text, replace, save, delete.
This file contains no signing key.
No password shared by your computers (on Windows: Preferences, “Share passwords”).
Passphrase rejected by your computers’ file. The certificate can also arrive without a passphrase: open PhilPDF on Windows once (version 0.9.52 or later), it puts it in the PhilPDF folder.
Signature rejected by the PDF engine.
Unreadable signature field in this PDF: draw a new signature box.
Google asks you to sign in again.
This version does not have PhilPDF’s %1$s identifier.
Ports %1$s are busy on this phone.
No answer within 5 minutes: please try again.
PhilPDF was not reopened: please try again.
%1$s did not give a lasting authorization: please try again.
%1$s: PhilPDF folder not found (sync with PhilPDF on Windows first).
Dropbox: the PhilPDF app is not allowed to create links (tick the “sharing.write” permission in the Dropbox console, then reconnect the account).
%1$s: sharing by link is not available.
No network for PhilPDF (%1$s). Check the connection, and that Data Saver does not block PhilPDF.
The original account is no longer linked: choose “Save as”.
The value must be between %1$s and %2$s.
The value must be at least %1$s.
The value must be at most %1$s.
Incorrect French social security number (check the key).
RECEIVED ON|PAID ON|APPROVED ON|PROCESSED ON|CERTIFIED COPY|CANCELLED|APPROVED|URGENT
Done: PhilPDF is linked to your %1$s.
Scanned page: its text is not recognized yet.
Changes (touch one to go back to it)
Sharp text on a white background, very light file: letters, invoices, forms.
Colors kept, background brightened and shadows removed: color documents, cards.
Like Color, but as light as possible to send by e-mail.
No retouching, only cropped and straightened: receipts, photos, ID cards.
No page yet: “Next page” to photograph the document, or “Import photos”.
No camera app on this phone: import photos instead.
PDFs and images, in this order, in a new PDF. Arrows to change the order.
No readable page in these files.
Left out (unreadable or protected by a password): %1$s
Translated by AI (your key), page by page as you read. The PDF is not changed.
Translation by AI (%1$s): check it for anything important. Tap “Translated” to go back to the original text.
Sent to %1$s: the answer usually takes 5 to 30 s.
You can add your own instruction to PhilPDF\'s (optional). E.g.: “stress the amounts”, “3-line summary”, “tell me if I must reply”.
Tell the AI what to do with the text. E.g.: “put it in the past tense”, “make it friendlier”, “translate into Spanish”.
“Calendar” opens your calendar with the event pre-filled: you check and save it yourself.
No %1$s model available with this key.
No AI key: enter your Claude or Gemini key (Home › AI).
Claude key refused (%1$s). It starts with “sk-ant-” and must be copied in full from console.anthropic.com (API keys), with credit on the account.
Gemini key refused: check it (Home › AI).
No answer in time: slow network or overloaded service.
A Gemini key is needed (Home › AI): Claude cannot return an image.
Quota at 0: the free key has no access to this model. Billing must be enabled on the Google project (aistudio.google.com › Billing).
Too many requests: per-minute quota reached, try again in a moment.
Keep this instruction to reuse later
Gemini can also return an image (scan “AI Magnificence”); Claude cannot.
The AI is reading the document...
Summary note added at the top of page 1.
To use AI, enter your Claude or Gemini key. Nothing is sent without your action, and PhilPDF warns you if the document contains sensitive data.
A Gemini key is needed: only Gemini can return an image (Claude cannot).
The passphrase chosen on your Windows computers (Preferences › Sync passwords).
PhilPDF uses YOUR Claude (Anthropic) or Gemini (Google) key: usage is billed by the provider on your account. Keys stay encrypted on this phone. Nothing is sent without your action.
Your instruction is sent with the paragraph text, followed by these rules:
The keys you set on your Windows computers, taken from PhilPDF\'s encrypted file on your account.
Take the keys from my Windows computers
No AI key in your computers\' file: tick “Sync passwords” in PhilPDF Windows Preferences.
Back to the text before AI
This document has no text (scan?): run text recognition first.

This document seems to contain sensitive data:

%1$s

Do you really want to send it to the AI (%2$s)?
AI text cut into lines as long as the original: adjust if needed, then “Apply”.
The AI is working on the text...
The %1$d page(s) will be sent to Gemini (Google), with your key, to be cleaned.\n\nThe AI may change a letter or a digit: proofread the document before using it.
On creation, each page is sent to Gemini (your key), which returns it as if from a scanner: straight, white background, no grain or shadow. Preview here: like Colour.
Page(s) %1$s: Gemini returned no image, they were enhanced on the phone (like Colour).

Adjust the angles so the text follows the grid: “Lines” rotates the page, “Verticals” straightens leaning edges and columns (sheet photographed at an angle). “Auto” measures both. Nothing changes before “Apply”.
The image of the first page will be sent to the AI (%1$s) to suggest a name (sender, subject, date). Send?
Suggested by AI: check the sender and the date.
Suggest a name with AI (sender, subject, date)

Draw a rectangle over each passage that must disappear (text, image, signature...). Nothing is removed before “Redact”; after that, the content no longer exists in the file and a black rectangle replaces it. “Undo” brings it back until the file is closed.
The %1$d marked area(s) will be removed from the file for good (text, images and drawings) and replaced by a black rectangle. Continue?
%1$d area(s) redacted: their content no longer exists in the file.
%1$d marked area(s) are not redacted yet.
This document already has a watermark (PhilPDF, Acrobat or other).
Nothing changes before “Apply”; afterwards, the Undo arrow removes what was added.
Nothing could be added (details in the log).
Codes: {page} page number, {pages} number of pages, {date} today\'s date.
This document already has a header or footer added by PhilPDF: it will be replaced.
Header and footer removed from %1$d page(s).
Header and footer added to every page.
Adjust while watching the preview, then “Clean up”: the chosen pages are replaced by their cleaned version. Text recognition (OCR) is offered afterwards; Undo goes back.
Erase black edges and lines along the edge
%1$d page(s) have real text (not a scan): once cleaned up, they become an image; their text can be found again after text recognition (OCR).
On your other computers (on a Drive)
The AI translates each paragraph and puts the translation in its place (layout kept, text made smaller if longer). The result is a NEW document, “name (EN).pdf”; the original does not change.
Save your changes first (floppy disk at the top), then translate: the translation is made from the saved file.
The AI is reading the document to explain it to you...

%1$d field(s) to fill in. Tell the AI what it needs to know (name, address, dates, numbers, choices...): it only fills in what you give it or what the document clearly says, and you check everything before it is written.
E.g.: Jean Martin, born 12/03/1970 in Lyon, 3 rue des Lilas 06000 Nice, renewal application...
Keep this information on this phone for next time (only sent to the AI)
The AI is reading the form...
Check each suggested value: nothing is written into the form before “Fill in”. Untick what you do not want, correct it. Undo works afterwards.
%1$d field(s) filled in with AI: read them over before saving.
This document has no fields to fill in. “Create a form” (Edit › Form) can add them first.
No folder learnt yet: your computers learn them when you file with PhilPDF; choose one below.
The open document does not change: a copy is sent under this name. Your choice is learnt for this sender, on all your computers.
The AI picks out the data from the document; you check, then copy or share it as text (it pastes into a spreadsheet).
e.g. patient name, date of birth, doctor, prescription date
Check and correct if needed, then copy or share.
Copied: paste it in your spreadsheet or message.
Touch a bookmark to rename it, change its page, add a sub-bookmark, move or delete it. Undo works on each change.
Delete the bookmark “%1$s” and its %2$d sub-bookmark(s)?
Sent to the PhilPDF developer, to improve the AI features: the feature, the service, your reason, your comment and the text below (you can shorten it). Your document is not sent.
Thank you, your report has been sent.
The report could not be sent (no connection?). Try again later.
Each linked account can be browsed, receive files, share by link and file documents. Adding an account never removes the others.
★ Preferred for sending and reading in the cloud: this account comes first to open your PDFs, send them, share by link and file them (otherwise the sync account).

Your pCloud e-mail address and password (pCloud WebDAV access, included in paid pCloud plans). The server, in Europe or the United States, is found automatically. The password stays encrypted on this phone. With two-step verification, accept pCloud\'s \"New login attempt\" e-mail.

pCloud refuses this e-mail address or password (neither in Europe nor in the United States). WebDAV requires a paid pCloud plan; with two-step verification, accept the \"New login attempt\" e-mail, then try again.
Your kDrive number, your Infomaniak e-mail address and your password; with two-step verification, an app password created in the Infomaniak Manager. WebDAV requires a paid kSuite plan.
Full WebDAV address of your NAS or server (for example the Synology \"WebDAV Server\" package, Nextcloud...), user and password. The password stays encrypted on this phone.
The address must start with https:// (or http:// on your local network).
The server refuses this user or password. With two-step verification, use an app password.
Choose an image (logo, photo...) for this account: it replaces the service\'s photo or initial.
No Gravatar photo for %1$s. Create one on gravatar.com with this address, or choose an image.
Android\'s file picker: phone storage, Google Drive, Dropbox, Box, OneDrive apps...
None of your linked accounts can make a share link (pCloud, kDrive and WebDAV by password cannot): link Google Drive, Dropbox, Box or OneDrive.
Send a link from another account
OneDrive, Dropbox, Box…: the PDF is placed in PhilPDF/Partages on that account (folder created if missing) and the link goes into the message in the same way. The link is also copied.
kDrive refuses WebDAV access (403): your kDrive plan does not allow it (kSuite Free, kSuite Standard, my kSuite). The address and password were received: you need a kDrive plan that includes WebDAV.
kDrive refuses the e-mail address or password (401). With two-step verification, create an application password in the Infomaniak Manager and use it here.
Name of the new folder in %1$s
Not allowed in a folder name: / \\ : * ? \" < > |
